items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI endpoints support OpenAI-compatible API
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI has introduced OpenAI-compatible API support for real-time inference endpoints. Users of the OpenAI SDK, LangChain, or Strands Agents can now invoke models on SageMaker AI by simply changing the endpoint URL, without needing a custom client, a SigV4 wrapper, or code rewriting. This development significantly simplifies the integration process for developers working with multiple AI platforms.
items.why_it_matters: This makes it easier for developers to leverage Amazon's infrastructure while using familiar OpenAI tools, enhancing cross-platform compatibility.
